menu.setAsDefault.en: Set Magical as Default for Calendar Files…

menu.app.removeAllData.en: Remove All App Data and Quit…

dialog.eventAccount.detail.en: Select the calendar account to add this event to.

dialog.defaultCalendar.explanationHandle.en: Invitations that arrive by email currently open in {handler}, which puts them in a calendar you may not work in.

dialog.defaultCalendar.explanationNoHand.en: Invitations that arrive by email would then open in the account you choose.

dialog.defaultCalendar.couldNotRead.mess.en: Magical could not read the current setting.

dialog.defaultCalendar.couldNotRead.deta.en: The helper that talks to macOS is not running. Reopening Magical usually fixes it.

dialog.defaultCalendar.devBuild.message.en: Only the installed Magical can be the default reader.

dialog.defaultCalendar.devBuild.detail.en: This only works in the installed app, not a development build.

dialog.defaultCalendar.alreadyDefault.me.en: Magical is already the default reader for calendar files.

dialog.defaultCalendar.alreadyDefault.de.en: Double-clicking a .ics invitation opens it here. To change that back, use Get Info on any .ics file in Finder.

dialog.defaultCalendar.claimed.message.en: Magical is now the default reader for calendar files.

dialog.defaultCalendar.claimed.detail.en: Double-clicking a .ics invitation will open it here. To change it back, use Get Info on any .ics file in Finder.

dialog.defaultCalendar.refused.message.en: Magical could not be made the default reader.

dialog.defaultCalendar.refused.detail.en: macOS refused the change. You can set it yourself with Get Info on any .ics file in Finder.

dialog.alertPermission.detail.en: Notifications are turned off for Magical, so meeting alerts and invitations will not appear. Turn them on in System Settings › Notifications › Magical.

dialog.diagnostics.privacyDetail.en: All email addresses, personal directories, and sensitive parameters have been automatically redacted. No credentials or message bodies are included.

dialog.diagnostics.prompt.en: What would you like to do?

dialog.expired.unreadableVersion.en: This build's version could not be read, so it is no longer supported.

dialog.expired.noTimestamp.en: This pre-release build carries no valid build timestamp, so it is no longer supported.

dialog.expired.expired.en: This pre-release build was compiled on {date} and has passed its 90-day expiry, so it is no longer supported.

dialog.expired.install.en: Visit {url} for the latest release and update details.

dialog.ics.unreadable.message.en: That calendar file could not be read.

dialog.ics.unreadable.detail.en: Magical could not open {file}. It may have been moved or deleted.

dialog.ics.rejected.message.en: Google Calendar did not import that file.

dialog.ics.rejected.detail.en: It found no events it could read in the file.

dialog.ics.finish.message.en: Finish the import in Google Calendar.

dialog.ics.finish.detail.en: {reason}. Google’s own import page is now open in {account} with the file already selected — press Import to finish.

dialog.ics.reason.paneRejected.en: The import pane did not accept the file

dialog.ics.reason.buttonUnavailable.en: The Import button could not be pressed

dialog.ics.reason.noReport.en: Google never reported what it did

dialog.ics.reason.unreadable.en: Google’s confirmation could not be read

dialog.ics.reason.paneUnavailable.en: The import pane could not be driven

dialog.removeAllData.message.en: Remove all app data and quit?

dialog.removeAllData.detail.en: {app} will remove the accounts and Google sessions stored on this Mac, along with its caches, preferences, login item and notifications. It will then quit. This cannot be undone.
